digest.component_or_area: LLM model routing and provider abstraction
propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries are bare Anthropic model names that resolve to direct Anthropic provider even when workflow is configured for another provider, creating a split-brain
Model escalation via sizing.models_at_or_above() returns bare Anthropic ids for a Bedrock-qualified primary, causing silent cross-provider escalation
Class names (trivial, standard, frontier) must resolve through a provider-aware config at runtime, not YAML load time, to enable provider portability
MODEL_LADDER serves dual roles (escalation order and P8 context budgets via substring match) that would break silently if ladder entries become class names without proper decoupling
Three separate code paths consume model_ladder entries without resolution: production_batch_runner.py, code_review/batch_runner.py, and workflow/runners.py
